answer_card.title: splunk.es removed legacy modules
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed deprecated modules and their replacements:

- `adaptive_response_notable_event` → `splunk.es.splunk_adaptive_response_notable_events`
- `correlation_search` → `splunk.es.splunk_correlation_searches`
- `data_input_monitor` → `splunk.es.splunk_data_inputs_monitor`
- `data_input_network` → `splunk.es.splunk_data_inputs_network`
